text:
maya: Quick question — for the console SLO editor: do we want thresholds to be contextual (traffic-type aware) or keep a single global threshold? we're getting a lot of noise on bursty routes.
ajay: leaning contextual. e.g. p99 for heavy tail/long requests, p95 for small interactive routes. UI/comprehension cost is the main blocker.
sophia: agree on context. BUT we need an API shape that can represent it. notify-api v1 expects a single numeric `threshold` per SLI. propose v2 accept an array like:
```json
[{"traffic_type":"batch","threshold":0.98},{"traffic_type":"interactive","threshold":0.995}]
```
samir: +1. Also we need explicit per-tenant overrides and an easy rollback if a mapping causes extra noise.
kevin: operational question — how does alert routing pick notify targets? do we map traffic_type -> team? we currently only route by service/owner tags, not traffic_type.
maya: proposal: we infer traffic_type from route tags (e.g., `route:interactive`) and allow an alert-policy mapping table in the console: `route-tag` -> `notify-targets`. UI shows a compact "Add mapping" row to avoid complexity.
sophia: UX idea: add a "sensitivity multiplier" slider that multiplies base thresholds for temporary noise suppression (effective_threshold = base * multiplier). saves having to edit arrays for on-call.
ajay: backward compat: if v2 receives a single threshold value (old clients), treat it as the default entry applied to all traffic_types.
devex-bot: FYI there's a draft UI mock in Figma: https://figma.com/file/xxx (see SLO editor > mappings) :eyes:
samir: important: persist `runbook_url` & `playbook_id` on each alert rule. alert controller should include that in the webhook/pager payload so downstream on-call can jump straight to instructions.
maya: also would be great to show a "recent-signal-preview" in the editor (last 7 days) with annotated firing points so owners can sanity-check thresholds before saving.
kevin: routing-wise can we reuse the existing escalation chain logic? mapping table evaluation should happen before default escalation to allow targeted dedup/avoid fanout.
deploy-bot: notify-api v2 deployed to staging at 2026-03-19T18:40Z :rocket:
maya: can someone validate tenant `acme-corp` who had a noisy alert spike yesterday? @ajay @samir
ajay: running integration test now against staging. mapping table works. two small issues: (1) preview graph missing legend, (2) payload size grows when thresholds array > 10 entries.
sophia: for payload size we can reference tag ids instead of repeating tag names and the server can expand. also add a soft cap (25 mappings) in the UI with a helpful hint.
samir: i'll open a backend PR to add `runbook_url` and compressed mapping refs; will add sample payload in the PR description and assign to @sophia for UI changes.
maya: thanks everyone. plan: canary roll for 48h on dedicated customers and track false-positive rate + alert volume delta. will follow up in tracking doc.
